# @fyit/crouton-three components

## CroutonThreeModelViewer

glTF/.glb model viewer with orbit controls and auto-rotate; renders a placeholder when no model is set

File: `app/components/ModelViewer.vue`

| Prop | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `src` | `string` | `""` | no | Model URL (.glb or .gltf) |
| `height` | `string \| number` | `400` | no | Viewer height (number = px, or any CSS length) |
| `background` | `string` | `"transparent"` | no | Background: 'transparent' (default) or any CSS/hex color |
| `autoRotate` | `boolean` | `true` | no | Auto-rotate the camera around the model |
| `autoRotateSpeed` | `number` | `2` | no | Auto-rotate speed (degrees/sec-ish, OrbitControls units) |
| `cameraPosition` | `[number, number, number]` | `[3, 3, 3]` | no | Camera position [x, y, z] |
| `grid` | `boolean` | `false` | no | Show a reference grid on the ground plane |

## CroutonThreeScene

TresJS canvas wrapper with camera, lights, optional orbit controls, and a default slot for arbitrary 3D content (meshes, models, game objects)

File: `app/components/Scene.vue`

| Prop | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `height` | `string \| number` | `480` | no | Canvas height (number = px, or any CSS length) |
| `background` | `string` | `"transparent"` | no | Background: 'transparent' (default), or any CSS/hex color the renderer should clear to |
| `controls` | `boolean` | `true` | no | Show orbit controls (drag to rotate, scroll to zoom) |
| `autoRotate` | `boolean` | `false` | no | Auto-rotate the camera around the scene (requires controls) |
| `cameraPosition` | `[number, number, number]` | `[5, 5, 5]` | no | Camera position [x, y, z] |
| `ambientIntensity` | `number` | `1` | no | Ambient light intensity |
| `grid` | `boolean` | `false` | no | Show a reference grid on the ground plane |
| `shadows` | `boolean` | `true` | no | Enable shadow maps |

| Slot | Props |
| --- | --- |
| `default` | `{}` |
